polity_1776: Junior Zhuz / Kişi Jüz Kazakh polity
linguistic_variants: Nuraly Khan; Нуралы хан; Нұралы хан
transliteration_notes: Russian sources often spell the Kazakh name Нуралы; modern Kazakh uses Нұралы. 'Junior Zhuz', 'Lesser Horde' and 'Kişi Jüz' refer to the same broad political-social grouping but should not be treated as a centralized standing army.
birth_date_precision: DISPUTED_YEAR—current e-history biography gives 1710/1711; some e-history chronology material gives 1704, so no exact day/month should be encoded
death_date_precision: SEASON_YEAR—died in Ufa; no exact day accepted
military_function: Khan of the Junior Zhuz. He could raise followers and had earlier military activity, but contemporary correspondence demonstrates that he lacked the coercive authority to command or restrain many autonomous war parties during the Pugachev-era crisis.
activity_on_1776_01_01: ACTIVE AS KHAN, NOT A UNIFIED FIELD COMMANDER. On 6 Aug 1774 Nuraly wrote that the Kazakhs were inclined to war against Russia, that he could not turn them back, and that his own strength was insufficient to stop them. Subsequent 1775–76 descriptions continue to show fragmented authority. This directly supports collective rather than individual command representation.
religion_precision: CONTEXTUAL—Kazakh elite Islamic milieu; no precise individual confessional statement needed for this conclusion
social_origin: Chinggisid/Töre aristocracy; eldest son of Abulkhair Khan and Bopay Khanım
portrait_reference: No authenticated contemporary portrait of Nuraly was verified in consulted sources.
alternative_or_exclusion: Do not attach Nuraly simply because he was khan. Named raid/war-party leaders existed, but no single individual can responsibly stand for all Kişi Jüz sarbaz groups on 1776-01-01. Current repo collective-structure flag is historically well supported.
repo_notes: Existing ruler record uses age=71, which would imply roughly 1704/1705 at the 1776 start and conflicts with the stronger 1710/1711 biographical chronology; do not turn the repo age into a historical birth date.
research_notes: This is the clearest COLLECTIVE_STRUCTURE case. The evidence is not an absence of a famous khan; it is positive contemporary evidence that the khan did not control the whole armed society represented by the formation.
